name: Skeleton, Burning, Shrine-Blessed
body:
Shrine-Blessed Burning Skeletons
CR 1

XP 400
NE Medium shrine-blessed undead
Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +0; Aura fiery aura (1d6)

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 12, flat-footed 14 (+2 armor, +2 Dex, +2 natural)(+2 deflection vs good creatures)
hp 5 (1d8+1)
Fort +3, Ref +4, Will +4; +2 vs good creatures
Defensive Abilities channel resistance +6; DR 5/bludgeoning; Immune fire, undead traits
Vulnerability cold

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee broken scimitar +2 (1d6+2 plus 1d6 fire), claw –1 (1d4+3 plus 1d6 fire) or 2 claws +4 (1d4+4 plus 1d6 fire)

STATISTICS

Str 15, Dex 14, Con —, Int —, Wis 10, Cha 12
Base Atk +0; CMB +4; CMD 14
Feats Improved InitiativeB
Gear broken chain shirt, broken scimitar
SQ fiery death (DC 11)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Fiery Aura (Ex)

Creatures adjacent to a burning skeleton take 1d6 points of fire damage at the start of their turn. Anyone striking a burning skeleton with an unarmed strike or natural attack takes 1d6 points of fire damage.

Fiery Death (Su)

A burning skeleton explodes into a burst of flame when it dies. Anyone adjacent to the skeleton when it is destroyed takes 1d6 points of fire damage. A Reflex save (DC 11) halves this damage.
